Advertisement View all journals Saved research Search Account Log in Content Explore content About the journal Publish with us Subscribe Sign up for alerts RSS feed nature nature water comments article Comment Published: 25 September 2026 Flood risk governance must put social vulnerability at the centre Aiperi Stambekova ORCID: orcid.org/0009-0003-0830-7736 1 & Avidesh Seenath ORCID: orcid.org/0000-0002-8268-8608 1 Nature Water ( 2026 ) Cite this article Save article View saved research Flood risk management has advanced rapidly in modelling flood routing and inundation patterns, yet the consequences of physically comparable floods continue to fall unevenly across communities. Anticipating where impacts will concentrate, therefore, requires looking beyond where floodwater will flow to identify who lacks the capacity to avoid, withstand, and recover from flooding.
